nodes.label: Flow 1: Lead to demo to subscription
nodes.rationale: SPEC §14 subscription flow. Revised per AMPM 2026-10-26: no self-serve demo; Sales authorises the demo, mobile OTP login, no expiry, optional 15-20 min Zoom call, basic wedding details captured before a Rs 50,000 online card/UPI payment, one-month subscription, renewal as a new purchase. Original diagram superseded; no anonymous checkout (WHY §4).

nodes.label: Flow 2: Hotel discovery and assistance
nodes.rationale: SPEC §14 hotel assistance. Availability checks are included in the subscription; negotiation, site visits, contract review and booking assistance are chargeable and need an accepted service agreement first. Indicative price ranges with a verified date; availability requested from a selection (Q9). An enquiry is never a confirmed booking.

nodes.label: Flow 3: Wedding engagement and project creation
nodes.rationale: SPEC §14 wedding engagement. A wedding project is created when a broader-services agreement is accepted; creation back-fills saved hotels, enquiries and agreements. Minimal mandatory fields (name, account, dates, lead); a project may be created while the first milestone is unpaid (bank transfer, recorded by Finance, Q4).

nodes.label: Flow 4: Vendor options, proposals and selection
nodes.rationale: Fewer than five options allowed, more than ten not blocked. Vendor contacts, raw quotes, internal cost and ratings never reach the client. A revision never overwrites a shared version; approval locks the budget line.

nodes.label: Flow 5: Versioned creative approvals (designs, menus, invitations)
nodes.rationale: Approval binds to an exact version; a new version supersedes without overwriting. Internal comments never shown to clients. Menu approval freezes the guaranteed headcount. Approving an invitation does not send it; distribution is a separate RSVP-team action in Flow 7.

nodes.label: Flow 6: Client requests (questions, change requests, support)
nodes.rationale: Questions and change requests are tracked requests; AMPM added live chat alongside them (Q20) — a conversation can be turned into a tracked request that then follows Flow 6 unchanged. Material changes raise impact flags and review tasks.

nodes.label: Flow 7: Invitations and RSVP
nodes.rationale: SPEC §14 RSVP. Revised per AMPM (Q7): bride-side/groom-side or one combined link; guests self-identify by name and phone; responses lock on submission; corrections go through the RSVP team; self-service and assisted entry write the same rows (no duplicates); representatives see summaries only. Original diagram superseded.

nodes.label: Flow 8: Rooms, travel and transport
nodes.rationale: Room blocks from the hotel contract; rooming from attending guests; travel segments and transfers; manifests exported without identity data. Allocations without a block are flagged; identity documents viewed at check-in only with an explicit grant.

nodes.label: Flow 9: Live execution
nodes.rationale: SPEC §14 execution. Offline operation required (U-7): run-of-show, checklists and arrival lists readable offline; cue updates and incident reports queue and sync. A function cannot go live with an open required item unless a Super Admin authorises an exception (Q10). Critical incidents need resolution notes; deploys frozen while any project is live (T-14).

nodes.label: Flow 10: Closure
nodes.rationale: Closure verifies departures, lost-and-found, vendor completion and financial reconciliation; ends with a feedback request and a read-only client window (three months) then archival on Super Admin approval. Records are never deleted at closure; only retention jobs delete, per class, and they propose deletions for approval (Q8, Q17).

nodes.label: Flow 11: Sign-in, activation, recovery and guest access
nodes.rationale: Cross-cutting auth. No public self-registration (WHY §4). Staff sign in with password plus authenticator-app code; clients and prospects use mobile OTP (Q13); guests use a token link bound to their household and never see a password screen.

nodes.label: Flow 12: Entitlement changes (expiry, suspension, closure window)
nodes.rationale: Job-driven entitlement lifecycle expressed as a table. Expiry/suspension/cancellation make data read-only without deleting it (GP-1). Closure sets client_access_until; after the window memberships are removed and the project archived. Nothing in this flow deletes data.

nodes.label: Parallel planning streams (BIZ rule 3)
nodes.rationale: BIZ rule 3 / SPEC §1.2: once a project exists (Flow 3), Flows 4, 5, 7 and 8 plus budget lines and approvals run concurrently and independently.
